name: Hybrid Lexicase + Multi-Op GP
tagline: Lexicase/tournament hybrid with adaptive parsimony, four-mode mutation, hill-climbing on constants, and random immigrants.
init_recovers: Parsimony GP at lexicase frac=0, mutation mix={subtree 100%}, no hill-climb, no immigrants.
diff_from_baseline: Compared to Lexicase or Parsimony GP individually, this stacks both (75/25 hybrid selection with auto-Cov/Var parsimony) and replaces single-operator subtree mutation with a 4-mode mutation distribution plus hill-climbing on the best individual's constants and 5% random immigrants — none of the named baselines combine these.

name: Lexicase-Parsimony GP
tagline: ε-lexicase selection with parsimony added to per-case errors plus subtree+point mutation.

key_hyperparams.name: parsimony injection
key_hyperparams.role: added to per-case errors before lexicase

init_recovers: Lexicase GP when τ=0 and mutation=100% subtree.
diff_from_baseline: Compared to plain Lexicase GP, the per-case error matrix is augmented by a length-scaled parsimony term (τ·median(E)·L) before ε-lexicase, and 30% of mutations become point mutations on individual nodes — Lexicase GP and Parsimony GP have only one of these mechanisms, never both.

name: Lexicase + Penalised Errors
tagline: ε-lexicase on per-case errors that are additively penalised by an adaptive parsimony coefficient.
diff_from_baseline: Compared to Lexicase GP, penalises every cell of the per-case error matrix by τ·L (auto Cov/Var with cap raised from 0.001 to 0.002) — i.e. parsimony pressure baked into ε-lexicase rather than into a scalar fitness; vs. Parsimony GP, the penalty is applied per-case under lexicase rather than to the scalar MSE.

name: Difficulty-Aware Tournament + Compaction
tagline: Hybrid scalar/case-difficulty tournament with size tie-breaking, near-elite compact archive, size-matched crossover.

key_hyperparams.name: parsimony cap
key_hyperparams.role: auto Cov/Var, applied to selection only

init_recovers: Parsimony GP-like behaviour at case-tournament prob=0, near-elite=0, fixed extra-mut=0.
diff_from_baseline: Compared to standard/parsimony/lexicase GP, parents are picked by a hybrid tournament that with 60% probability targets the case with highest current population error (a "residual focus" sampler) and breaks ties by size; crossover prefers donor subtrees of similar size and retries 3×; up to 2 near-best individuals are added to the elite slot.

name: Pareto-Lexicase GP
tagline: Pre-filter the population by penalised fitness (top 40%), then run ε-lexicase, with extra point and hoist mutations.

key_hyperparams.name: Pareto pre-filter
key_hyperparams.role: shrink lexicase pool by penalised score

init_recovers: Plain ε-lexicase when n_keep = pop and τ = 0.
diff_from_baseline: Adds two pieces vs. Lexicase GP: (i) a Pareto-style pre-filter that trims the lexicase candidate pool to the top 40% by penalised fitness, and (ii) extra point and hoist mutation operators (each 2%) — Lexicase GP runs ε-lexicase over the entire population with subtree mutation only.
